thread.document:
This report summarizes my work with Mistral on HW4 coding problems. Mistral initially struggled with strict coding constraints (Problem 5) but quickly adapted and produced correct minimal code. It handled dataset setup, training, and loader tasks effectively, and excelled in hyperparameter tuning through iterative feedback.

Its written explanations showed strong conceptual understanding of CNNs, covering topics like inductive bias, domain shift, and model behavior on permuted images.

Key Points

Minor issues in Problem 5 (strict coding constraints), mostly smooth completion elsewhere.

Hyperparameter tuning and conceptual explanations were particularly strong.
